_about: The hardened CI job. It evaluates BOTH the full-precision model and the artefact it will ship, compares them, and refuses to sign if the shipped file behaves differently.
_slice_gate: true = gates.slice_gate() runs too. It passes everything until you write it (challenge 1).
_rich_bom: true = the ML-BOM records the base model and its hash (pedigree.ancestors) and the eval numbers of the shipped file.
